Owner-authored material supplied under this release uses kicad-web-view Source-Available License 1.0; see LICENSE and LICENSING.md. Commercial use requires explicit prior written permission. Original source identities and hashes are retained in SOURCE-PROVENANCE.json.

The 3D bundle includes Three.js 0.171.0 (MIT; engine/vendor/THREE-LICENSE) and fzstd 0.1.1 (MIT; engine/vendor/fzstd/LICENSE). The owner subset is retained under engine/spike-source; provenance is in engine/vendor/SPIKE-ENGINE-NOTICE.md. Rebuilding does not relicense the rest of SPIKE or revoke earlier grants.

The OCCT STEP decoder/runtime, PDF.js, KiCanvas and host applications are not included. The optional Altium adapter loads an external service only on explicit load(); it does not bundle or relicense Altium software.
